description: A repeating architectural module (a wall bay, a column, a stair run). Bigger than a prop and seen from further away, so the prop preset's 512 px/m is unreachable: a 15 m wall bay would need an 8K sheet. 2048 with an 80 px/m target keeps the warning meaningful. Thickness and AO baking are off -- SketchUp-derived architecture is riddled with non-manifold edges and both bakes leak through them.
